release_notes: FIXES test-server 404s: install_debian.sh generated Apache vhosts with 'DocumentRoot ...; ServerName ...' on ONE line (invalid Apache syntax — the ';' makes ServerName part of DocumentRoot) for panel ports 2086/2087/2096, producing a broken vhost where every panel page returned 404. Fixed by splitting to separate lines (matches the working live vhost). The RHEL installer (installer/install.sh) previously created only a port-80 vhost and NO panel ports, so the panel was unreachable on 2082/2086/2087/2096 — it now writes radiohosting-panel-ports.conf with AllowOverride All + front-controller rewrite + Listen directives. Both verified bash-syntax clean; the generated vhost now matches the proven-working live panel-ports.conf.
